The announcement came from the department’s Joint Criminal Opioid and Darknet Enforcement team, or JCODE, an FBI-led group created in 2018. Officials said Operation TorNado is the sixth, and most extensive, internationally coordinated action since then, and that it builds on last year’s Operation RapTor. The sweep ran from May 2025 to October 2026. Europol, which coordinated work with agencies in 14 countries, published a parallel statement the same day. The operation targeted vendors and buyers who had been active on five dark web markets already seized by law enforcement: Archetyp, Bohemia, Nemesis, Kingdom and Tor2Door. Officials also identified accounts on DrugHub and on forums, single-vendor shops and encrypted messaging services. The seizures included about 5.7 metric tons of illicit drugs worldwide, among them fentanyl and other opioids, methamphetamine, heroin, cocaine, ecstasy and MDMA, plus 38 pill presses and 209 firearms.

How it works Your browser encrypts the search before sending it. The transaction ID, block or address never leaves your device in readable form. A search for something that exists looks the same as a search for something that doesn’t. As far as we know, it’s the first full block explorer (transactions, blocks and addresses) built on PIR. events.excerpt: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Simon Dixon: What It Would Take for Me to Sell My Bitcoin for Gold Simon Dixon, CEO and co-founder of BnkToTheFuture, tells BMTV there are only three things that would make him sell all of his Bitcoin and buy gold. Since 2011, he says Bitcoin has done three things incredibly well: you can earn and hold it in self-custody, spend it peer-to-peer without a government in the middle, and rely on a fixed supply of 21 million as a hedge against long-term debasement. events.excerpt: Summary This proposal introduces post-quantum signature aggregation with leanVM in shadow mode . BLS remains the only authority for aggregates: consensus validity depends on BLS alone, exactly as today. leanVM aggregates and proofs are produced and verified alongside BLS, but their results have no effect on consensus. They are only measured, compared, and reported. When PQ/AI day arrives, an emergency hard fork simply retires BLS and enables leanVM in full. By “PQ/AI day” we mean the point at which quantum computers, or AI-assisted cryptanalysis, make BLS unsafe to rely on. Motivation Ethereum has to be ready for post-quantum signatures well before BLS is actually broken. Waiting until the last moment would mean deploying new, complex code to mainnet in a hurry. Giving leanVM authority early has its own risk: leanVM is new code that hasn’t been tested in production. However carefully it is built and audited, we can’t rule out a soundness bug that accepts an invalid proof, or a liveness bug that rejects a valid one. The main benefit of shadow mode is that Ethereum isn’t put at risk from a leanVM bug before PQ/AI day arrives.
